# `factorial`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
factorial(expr)
```

Returns the factorial of `expr`. `expr` is [0..20]. Otherwise, null.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `math_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT factorial(5);
```

Result:

```text
120
```
